249.insights: • $1.78 consistently yields the highest profit (~$52.58) when Firm A is in its usual 2.4‑2.5 range. • Profit is relatively flat across $1.75‑$1.80; small differences are within noise. • When Firm A’s price rises above ~2.55, quantity and profit increase; a modest price increase to $1.85‑$1.90 then becomes optimal. • Rare spikes in Firm A price (≥ 2.8) generate the best profit; monitoring for such streaks is key. • Moving‑average profit > 53 is a reliable indicator that Firm A is pricing high enough to justify testing a higher price. • Moving‑average profit < 52 signals a low‑price environment where a slight price cut to $1.75 may protect volume.
